name: Almost Heaven Rainelle 4-Person Indoor Sauna
description: Almost Heaven Rainelle 4-Person Respite Series Sauna – The Perfect Indoor Hybrid Sauna The Rainelle’s unique glass design lends both privacy and natural light to the sauna experience. The two full-length, multi-level benches offer plenty of room for you and three friends to enjoy the heat, or you can stretch out on your own. The Harvia 6kW electric heater can either delay the start time up to eight hours, or can turn on right away. The space will get up to temperatures of 180ºF after an hour of heating. Whether in your bathroom, basement, garage, or spare room, enjoy an authentic sauna experience in the Rainelle! Features Tongue-and-groove lumber sections: 1-3/8” finished thickness Pre-assembled wall and roof sections Utilizes the existing floor. Suitable options include concrete, ceramic, vinyl, laminate, or tile flooring (carpet not recommended) Tempered glass door Stainless steel hinges, heater, and fasteners Interior LED light Two full-length benches, multi-level seating Indoor usage Hand-crafted construction Easy assembly for two people Best-in-class heater & sauna stones Limited lifetime warranty on the sauna room; 5-year limited lifetime warranty on the heater and its components, with a 1-year warranty on the heating elements (coils) Made in the USA Specifications Holds up to four people Heater size: 6 kW, 240V , 30-amp requirement, hard-wire connect Lighting electrical: 110V, 15-amp service, plug-in connect Exterior dimensions: 71″W x 63″D x 78″H Interior dimensions: 66″W x 58″D x 77″H Upper bench size: 66″L x 22″ W x 38″H Lower bench size: 66″L x 14″W x 23″H Door size: 64″H x 24″W Window size: 64″H x 25″W Shipping size: 74″L x 40″W x 49″H Assembled weight: 720 lbs. Shipping weight: 785 lbs. Options & Customizations Lumber type: Choose between three different types of solid lumber. Rustic fir is light in color, with small knots creating a unique pattern on each piece. Rustic cedar has a slightly red hue amongst the knots and boasts a pleasant cedar aroma. Clear cedar is premium lumber, with knots noticeably absent. All three lumber options are 1 ⅜” thick to insulate the sauna room. Door style: Outfit your sauna with one of the following four door options: deluxe glass, fading glass, wood with a window, all-wood. Heater: You can upgrade the Rainelle from the standard 6kW heater to an 8kW. You can also add the luxury and ease of WiFi controls with the Harvia KIP60W or KIP80W with a Xenio WiFi Control Panel. Shipping & Assembly The Rainelle will ship via an LTL truck and will arrive curbside on a single pallet. Some basic handyman skills are helpful when assembling the sauna. The only additional equipment needed is a cordless drill. Two people can generally do the assembly in 6 hours or less. It is recommended that you review the assembly manual in advance to familiarize yourself with the process. Care & Maintenance Traditional saunas require very little upkeep. Simply wipe down the interior after each use and check for any dust or debris that you may have tracked in. Read more about long-term care and maintenance here. Two Ways to Enjoy Your Sauna Heater and stones are essential to a traditional sauna experience. With the room at least heated to 160ºF, the traditional sauna can be enjoyed in two ways. The first is called a dry sauna, which lacks any added moisture. The second is called a wet sauna, where you sprinkle water onto the heated stones to create a refreshing burst of steam and added humidity. Resources Rainelle Installation & Owner's Manual Videos
